notes: Baseline release of the Settings & Passlock suite. Deploy a new build with an incremented version tag (e.g. AQ-SYS-V2.2-PRO) in this file and connected clients will surface an Update Available banner automatically.

changelog.title: System Settings & Passlock Suite
items: Full User Management panel with role assignment, activation control and audit-ready records
Password & Account Security center with strength metering and change-password flow
App Passlock: quick PIN, master password and WebAuthn biometric (Windows Hello / Touch ID) unlock
Configurable auto-lock on startup and idle timeout (5 / 15 / 30 minutes) plus Ctrl+L / Cmd+L manual lock
Live software update engine polling a remote version.json release manifest

changelog.title: Logistics & Reporting Expansion
items: Comprehensive print option for freight shipments & logistics tracking
Official receipts register redesign with routing details and dual signatures
Direct print and summary register report for Official Deposit Receipts
